summary: Bank of Montreal (BMO) filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the redemption of $1 billion in 1.928% Series K Medium-Term Notes (Non-Viability Contingent Capital, Subordinated Indebtedness) due July 22, 2031. The redemption occurs on July 22, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. Approval was obtained from the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions. This is a routine debt redemption and capital management action, not a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer's current report under Rule 13a-16; no special-situation classification applies.
